paragraphs: Rabbi Chanilai bar Chanilai: Avodah Zarah 18b. Nechemyah son of Rav Chanilai: Eruvin 43b.

notes.text: The checked passages attest Rav Chana bar Chanilai, Rabbi Chanilai bar Chanilai, Nechemyah son of Rav Chanilai, and Rabbi Tanchum bar Chanilai at the supplied Bavli locators. This is a collection of patronymic attestations, not proof of one shared father. The heading’s R’ preserves the abbreviated title without assigning every listed father the son’s independently attested title.
